messages:
yara: FYI we got a heads-up from vendor-lyra: crew change at the MED transload yard (ALG) caused a hold on the container with our Wave-58 H100 RMA tranche. ETA shift ~36h.

diego: Which pool are these for? any live infra impacted?

yara: 10 units: 6 for pool-eu-edge (RMA replacements) and 4 spare top-off. The 6 replacements are serving live; risk if delay >24h.

vendor-lyra: Confirmed 3 crew rotation + terminal gate backlog at ALG. Two vendor options: 1) local gate rework (re-stow) ~3648h + yard fee $1,100, keep sea manifest; 2) express airbridge: move 6 priority H100s via short-haul air from ALG->MXP then on to AMS (air bridge)  uplift +17% freight, handling $600/unit, insurance +1.0% declared. Both require AWB/manifest updates and serial mapping.

ops-bot: Ticket created: LYR-2024-1102 "ALG crew-change hold -> decide re-stow vs express airbridge". Assigned to @yara and vendor-lyra.

customs-bot: Note: airbridge via MXP will demand re-export docs from ALG and ECCN flagged on commercial invoice. If value-per-unit > $40k trigger pre-clear.

storage-team: If airbridge goes to AMS, we need crate dims and pallet heights for our EU DC booking. Also request temporary storage SLA for the 4 sea units if we split.

yara: Ops preference: avoid full charter if yard fix <36h. Proposal: vendor do in-place re-stow for the 4 spares, airbridge the 6 replacements. That minimizes SLA risk and cost. Vendor, can you split and provide AWBs/serial list for the 6? Also include REDWOOD-RMA ref in manifest.

vendor-lyra: We can split. Provisional AWBs for airbridge: 
```
AWB: 990-5502201
AWB: 990-5502202
AWB: 990-5502203
AWB: 990-5502204
AWB: 990-5502205
AWB: 990-5502206
```

vendor-lyra: We'll tag manifest refs with "REDWOOD-RMA | PO:2024-9730" and upload serial CSV + crate dims in the portal. We'll also append return RMA labels for 3 flagged DOA units into the manifest references and provide pickup SLA so inbound swap at DC can be direct. Portal: https://vendor.lyra.example.com/uploads?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9730

diego: Finance: please accept conditional quick-approve for airbridge uplift to PO# 2024-9730 (up to +17% freight + handling lines). Request vendor include invoice addendum and credit policy: if any serial mismatch >1 unit, vendor to credit immediate replacement cost.

vendor-lyra: Accept credit clause for mismatch >1 unit. We'll hold final billing until ops confirms route. We'll generate invoice addendum and AWB upload in ~90m.

customs-bot: Small operational note: when splitting manifests across sea->air, ensure the AWB includes manifest reference column with the original bill of lading number to avoid customs re-queue on arrival.

yara: Good call. storage-team: once AWBs and dims live, please run the earmark to pin the six to pool-eu-edge. Snippet: 
```
# earmark airbridge replacements
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-eu-edge --ref REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 990-5502201,990-5502202,990-5502203,990-5502204,990-5502205,990-5502206
```

storage-team: Copy. We'll prep AMS inbound slot and stage fork/trap support. Need crate jaw width and pallet height from vendor.

vendor-lyra: Will include fork spec, pallet height, and gross weights in upload. Also, if ALG hold exceeds 48h we recommend fallback to BLQ air-hub (Bologna) to avoid MXP congestion; cost delta +2%. We'll include that scenario in the addendum.

yara: OK. One more ask: for the 4 sea units kept at ALG, can vendor include RMA return pickup labels for the 2 DOA flagged earlier so we can do 1:1 swap when they re-enter the pool? That avoids quarantines.

vendor-lyra: Affirmative 3 we'll append return labels and pickup SLA for the ALG-hold units.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 12h check-in on LYR-2024-1102.

yara: Thanks team  please post AWBs and invoice addendum here when ready. :thumbsup: vendor-lyra: standing by.

vendor-lyra: Uploading docs and invoice addendum in ~75m. :white_check_mark:
